purpose: Teach: 鯖/潤/絶大/ホイール/鳴り/マキ/飛ばす/ゾンビ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、鯖の煮物、また、作ってって、頼んでたよ、本当に、お父さん、好物なんだよね、ぼく、覚えてるよ。
lines.en: Mom, Dad — he asked me again to make that mackerel stew. It's his favorite. I remember that.
lines.style: Bright, observant tone. Slight lift on 'again' — he's noticed the pattern. Warm and proud to be remembering something important. Natural child rhythm, no rushing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お風呂上がりの、お肌、潤いがあって、気持ちいいわよね、翔くん、ローション、塗ってあげるからね、ね、約束。
lines.en: Yes. Your skin feels so nice and soft right after a bath, doesn't it, Sho? I'll put lotion on for you — that's a promise.
lines.style: Gentle, soothing cadence. Warm smile underneath the words. Slow, unhurried — the voice of someone making a small ritual feel safe. Slight settling quality on 'promise.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 運動会の応援、お父さん、絶大な声で、応援してくれたよ、ぼく、嬉しかったよ、ママ、お父さん、本当に、すごかった!
lines.en: Dad cheered for me at the sports day — so loud, Mom! I was so happy. Dad was really amazing!
lines.style: Bright burst of pride at the memory. Quick, excited pace on the opening. Genuine warmth on 'so loud' — not mocking, admiring. Ends with a little glow of certainty.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、自転車の、ホイール、新しく、買ってあげたって、お祖父ちゃんから、聞いたわよ、翔くん、よかったわね、嬉しいわよね、ね。
lines.en: I heard from Grandpa that Dad bought you new bike wheels, Sho. That was nice, wasn't it? You must be happy.
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Unhurried pace. Slightly conversational — she's bringing him into the remembering. Soft confirmation at the end, like she's settling a small, happy fact into place.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祭りの、鐘が、鳴り響いて、楽しい雰囲気、出てきたね、ママ、ぼく、本当に、楽しみだよ、お祭り、絶対、行きたいよ!
lines.en: The festival bell is ringing and there's such a fun feeling in the air, Mom! I'm really excited. I absolutely want to go!
lines.style: Eager, bouncing energy. Quick on the opening image — the bell catches him. Building momentum toward 'absolutely want to go' — real anticipation, not performed. Genuine child excitement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達のマキちゃん、翔くん、よく、遊んでるよね、優しいお友達でいいわね、ママも、嬉しいわよ、翔くん、お友達、大切にしてね、ね。
lines.en: You play with Maki a lot, Sho. She's such a kind friend. I'm happy about that too. Take care of your friendships, okay?
lines.style: Warm, gentle guidance. Observant tone — she's noticed something good and is naming it. Slight lift of approval on 'kind friend.' Soft, caring quality on the closing — gentle direction, not instruction.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、新しい車で、お母さん、買い物に、飛ばすの、たまに、するよね、ぼく、後ろで、楽しんでるよ、本当に、家族のドライブ、好き。
lines.en: Dad drives pretty fast in the new car when he takes Mom shopping — and you like riding in the back, don't you? You really do love family car rides.
lines.style: Warm observation with a hint of fondness for her husband's ways. Conversational, knowing tone. Slight smile on 'drives pretty fast' — she's amused, not disapproving. Settles warmly on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、ゾンビ映画、結構、好きなのよね、翔くんは、まだ、怖いかな、大きくなったら、一緒に、見れるわよね、ね、楽しみね、家族で。
lines.en: Dad really likes zombie movies, you know. You might still find them scary — but when you're older, we can watch them together. That'll be fun, all of us as a family.
lines.style: Tender, slightly dreamy quality. Soft gaze toward a future moment. Unhurried pace. Gentle on 'scary' — acknowledging without pressure. Closes with warm certainty about what's ahead.
